content.text:
I've submitted **index 3 (Sb fraction 0.3046)** as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, **0.034%**. All 5 EQE measurements are used. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phase is behind the peak is unknown.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.2174 | 0.0125 |
| **3** | **0.3046** | **0.0339** |
| 4 | 0.3608 | 0.0190 |
| 12 | 0.5031 | 0.0019 |
| 22 | 0.6708 | 0.0008 |

- **The Pb-rich side is much better.** The two compositions near the known Pb–Sb oxide compounds (Sb fraction 0.50 and 0.67) came out about 10 to 40 times lower.
- **The peak is roughly between Sb 0.22 and 0.36.** Index 3 is higher than the points on either side of it. For the last measurement I chose index 3 because the Gaussian-process model suggested it; index 2 (0.2675) was its second choice.
- **Not measured:** index 0 (0.1947), index 2 (0.2675), and indices 5–7 (0.38–0.42) are unmeasured. The best composition on the line could be slightly off index 3, so the score may not be the maximum.
